name: S3 Browser Plus
description: S3-compatible object storage plugin for DBX, a community fork of S3 Browser with upload, preview, and connection-form enhancements.
releaseNotes: Initial release of S3 Browser Plus, a fork of S3 Browser (io.github.t8y2.s3, Apache-2.0): drag-and-drop uploads with target-directory picker, batch conflict strategies, 3-way concurrent upload queue panel, collapsible preview pane with persisted layout, server-side prefix search, and provider endpoint examples in the connection form.

zh-CN.name: S3 Browser Plus
zh-CN.description: S3 兼容对象存储插件，S3 Browser 社区增强版：上传体验、预览面板与连接表单增强。
